OSL Indonesia was previously a member of CFX. As a licensed self-regulatory organization (SRO) for digital financial assets under the supervision of Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK), as well as the country's first integrated digital financial asset infrastructure ecosystem, ICEX Group remains committed to supporting the development of a secure, transparent, and compliant digital financial asset market in Indonesia.
